I assumed fitting an underground fountain basin would need another person and hours of digging, but I set this up entirely on my own quickly. The shallow body cuts down digging work a lot, and there’s no confusing assembly hardware. Just level the ground, bury the basin, then add your pump and fountain rock. Perfect for anyone new to garden water feature projects.
